title: Normalized derived coefficient sections and total-limit comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. Work on its small pro-etale site with independent object, arrow and coefficient universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be the completed integral coefficient sheaf and $B_n=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^{n+1})_W$, so index zero is a positive quotient [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of the actual coefficient sequence-site modules, their exact evaluations $e_n$, scalar restrictions and the specified total inverse limit $L$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Fix reduction data $R$ and assume its finite scalar tensor comparison has the stated K-flat pure-tensor normalization [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data, def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. There exist CoefficientDerivedSectionsNormalization data: (1) ordinary scalar-section comparisons act by the actual sectionwise adjunct $f\mapsto(b\mapsto b f(1))$ and their derived comparisons satisfy the universal-unit equations; (2) the actual derived tower-sections functor commutes with every finite evaluation, before internal Hom; (3) an isomorphism $\kappa:L;R\Gamma_A\cong U;R(\Gamma_A^{\mathbf N});R\lim_{\mathrm{Ab}}$ satisfies the simultaneous ordinary-sections/limit universal-unit equation; (4) its actual nth projection followed by finite sections evaluation equals sections of the total-limit projection followed by scalar-section comparison, for every system; (5) on H-zero the finite enriched scalar comparison, under the fixed coefficientHomZeroEquiv identifications [def-coef-hom-zero-cycle-class, def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation], is the inverse of the specified finite scalar adjunction Hom equivalence. These data assert no system internal-Hom fiber isomorphism, gamma identity, or existence of reduction.

proof.text: Use the normalized sequence global sections theorem on the actual quotient tower. The ordinary limit-of-sections model and Hom from the module unit are identified by evaluation at 1, with inverse x sent to b mapped to b times x. This fixes the ordinary scalar formula. Transport the universal derived pairs along these ordinary isomorphisms; their scalar-unit and finite-evaluation equations give scalar coherence and systemSectionsEvaluation.

Apply the simultaneous sections/limit theorem to the same normalized pairs. Universal derived comparisons identify its limits and projections with the prescribed ones. The ordinary comparison is coefficientSectionsLimitIso since every ordinary projection agrees. After whiskering exact restriction the universal-unit equation is CoefficientSectionsLimitResolutionEquation; the theorem's arbitrary-system projection clause is sections_projection.

Represent P by a K-flat complex and M by a K-injective complex. The finite tensor normalization and closed uncurry_model fields identify the enriched scalar map with the ordinary extension/restriction Hom transpose. The fixed H-zero cocycle normalization sends a cocycle to its derived morphism, and the ordinary scalar sections formula is b tensor x mapped to b times f(x). The normalized derived scalar adjunction therefore proves scalar_hom_zero for every class.
